detail.longDescription: I've updated the option/optionAs APIs for https:// codeberg.org/hgrsd/zopt such that if an option argument is provided more than once, the last value wins. This allows things like overriding a baked-in option value for a command alias. If you want to get all option values for an option that supports multiple, you can continue to use the optionRepeated API. # ziglang # zig # cli # opensource # programming # noAI
